第15章鬼上身
中邪？
林熙眉梢一挑，爽快应下。
那头老太太一听顿时激动的和她约好了时间，半个小时后出发，给孙子看“病”
自然是越快越好。
于是半个小时后，林熙再次来到街口，那位老太太已经在街口等着了。
这次来到街口的时候，林熙终于看到她唯一的活人邻居，街口那家丧葬用品店的老板，是个二十多岁的年轻男人，正坐在店里玩手机。
只可惜眼下她还有急事要处理，暂时没空和邻居打招呼。
在见到老太太后，林熙便跟随她的脚步出发去孙子家了。
自然的，林熙也就没有看到身后那家店老板在看到她背影的时候眼珠子瞪得有多大，手机都哐当一声掉地上去了。
三秒后，店内传出一阵惊恐的叫声。
“救救救救救，救命啊——！”
妈妈，我要回家，我不守店了！
……
老太太是之前加林熙联系方式时强颜欢笑的那位，姓周，她让林熙叫她周奶奶。
林熙：“……”
心中无声叹了口气，最终还是按照这具身体的年龄老实的叫了她一声周奶奶。
周奶奶的孙子并没有和她住一块，而是和父母住在距离丧葬一条街三站外的小区，隔壁就是江渝一中，是寸土寸金的学区房。
老太太开了一辆老年代步电动三轮车，邀请林熙坐在后座，还别说，虽然速度慢，但是稳啊，头顶还有遮阳棚，也不怕风吹日晒的。
林熙扫了几眼，不由得有些心动。

而在去孙子家的路上，周奶奶快速把孙子的情况跟她说了一下。
周奶奶的孙子叫吴斌，是江渝一中一名高二学生，九月份开学即将进入高三。
现在正是八月，吴斌和几个同学决定趁着还没步入最可怕的高三，抓紧最后一个暑假痛痛快快的玩几天。
于是一群小伙子商量了一番，决定去江渝市底下一个有名的区县游玩。
区县那边有一个相当出名的自然瀑布，节假日省内省外都有不少人前往拍照打卡，还有一些网红在瀑布附近拍国风变装视频。
吴斌有个同学打听到他喜欢的一个女网红就在最近要去瀑布拍摄，他立马推荐了那个景点，其余人听了之后也没反对。
正好夏天这么热，那边有瀑布肯定很凉快，当然还有距离等原因，去太远的地方父母不放心，附近区县这点距离就刚刚好，不远，但也能让孩子们短暂的有自由空间。
他们定好只去两天，父母那边也都同意了，一群人高高兴兴的出发，可是两天之后吴斌拖着疲惫的身躯回来，一切就变得不对劲了。
一开始吴斌父母还以为儿子是赶车太累了，所以回来的时候脸色不太好看，整个人也浑浑噩噩没什么精神，他们没多想，只让儿子进屋好好休息。
结果第二天刚起床，就发现客厅有人说话的声音，夫妻俩出卧室一看，就发现儿子吴斌竟然在对着空气自言自语。
不，说自言自语并不准确，因为他听上去像是在和谁进行对话一样，有问有答的，中间还有停顿。
可夫妻俩定睛一看，却看到儿子对面空无一人，只有空气。

Chapter 15 The ghost takes over
Possessed by evil spirits?
Lin Xi raised her eyebrows and agreed readily.
When the old lady heard this, she was excited and made an appointment with her. She set off half an hour later to see her grandson's "disease."
Naturally, the faster, the better.
So half an hour later, Lin Xi came to the street corner again, and the old lady was already waiting at the street corner.
When she came to the street this time, Lin Xi finally saw her only living neighbor, the owner of the funeral supplies store at the street. He was a young man in his twenties, sitting in the store playing with his mobile phone.
It's a pity that she has urgent matters to deal with right now, so she doesn't have time to say hello to her neighbors for the time being.
After meeting the old lady, Lin Xi followed her footsteps and set off to her grandson's house.
Naturally, Lin Xi didn't see how big the shop owner's eyes were when he saw her back, and his cell phone dropped to the ground with a clang.
Three seconds later, a panicked cry came from the store.
“Help, help, help, help—!”
Mom, I want to go home, I won’t keep the store!
…
The old lady was the one who forced a smile when adding Lin Xi's contact information before. Her surname was Zhou. She asked Lin Xi to call her Grandma Zhou.
Lin Xi: "..."
I sighed silently in my heart, and finally called her Grandma Zhou honestly according to the age of this body.
Grandma Zhou's grandson does not live with her. Instead, he lives with his parents in a community three stops away from Funeral Street. Next door is Jiangyu No. 1 Middle School, which is a school district house with a high price tag.
The old lady drove an electric tricycle for the elderly and invited Lin Xi to sit in the back seat. Not to mention, although the speed was slow, it was stable. There was an awning above the head, so it was not afraid of the wind and sun.
Lin Xi glanced at it a few times and couldn't help but feel a little moved.
On the way to her grandson's house, Grandma Zhou quickly told her about her grandson's condition.
Grandma Zhou’s grandson is Wu Bin, a sophomore in Jiangyu No. 1 Middle School and will enter his senior year in September.
It was August now, and Wu Bin and several classmates decided to have a few days of fun in the last summer vacation before entering the most terrifying senior year of high school.
So a group of young men discussed it and decided to visit a famous district and county under Jiangyu City.
There is a quite famous natural waterfall in the district and county. Many people from inside and outside the province go there to take photos and check in during holidays. There are also some Internet celebrities filming Chinese-style cross-dressing videos near the waterfall.
One of Wu Bin's classmates found out that a female internet celebrity he liked was going to shoot at a waterfall recently. He immediately recommended that scenic spot, and the others did not object after hearing it.
It just so happens that the summer is so hot, and the waterfall there must be very cool. Of course, there are also reasons such as distance. Parents are worried about going to a place that is too far away. The distance in the nearby districts and counties is just right, not far, but it can also allow the children to have some free space for a short time.
They decided to only go there for two days, and their parents agreed. A group of people set off happily. However, two days later, Wu Bin came back with a tired body, and everything became wrong.
At first, Wu Bin's parents thought that their son was too tired from driving, so when he came back, his face was not very good, and he was feeling groggy and lacked energy. They didn't think much about it and just let their son go inside and have a good rest.
As soon as they got up the next day, they heard someone talking in the living room. When the couple came out of the bedroom, they found that their son Wu Bin was talking to himself in the air.
No, talking to himself is not accurate, because it sounded like he was having a conversation with someone, asking and answering questions, with pauses in between.
But when the couple took a closer look, they saw that there was no one across from their son, just air.
